subject.title: feat(skills): capture reusable techniques from successful work

question: Should `skills.workshop.autonomous.enabled` also authorize delayed second-model transcript review, or should successful-work review require a separate explicit opt-in?
rationale: The PR changes the cost and privacy meaning of an existing persisted setting for current opt-in users, and repository policy does not let code review infer that consent boundary.

options.title: Keep one autonomy opt-in
options.body: Treat the existing broad autonomy flag as consent for both correction capture and delayed successful-work review, with explicit upgrade and cost/privacy documentation.

options.title: Add a separate review opt-in
options.body: Gate delayed successful-work review behind a distinct setting so existing autonomous-capture users do not acquire new background model behavior on upgrade.

options.title: Pause background review
options.body: Keep deterministic correction capture only until maintainers define a narrower self-learning consent and lifecycle model.

recommendation.title: Keep one autonomy opt-in
recommendation.body: Treat the existing broad autonomy flag as consent for both correction capture and delayed successful-work review, with explicit upgrade and cost/privacy documentation.
